entry.summary: 对于 complete measure space $\(X\,cal(A)\,mu\)$, $\(Y\,cal(B)\,nu\)$, 取它们的 product measure space 的 completion: $ \(X times Y\,accent(cal(A) times.o cal(B), macron)\,accent(mu times nu, macron)\) $ 我们将 $accent(cal(A) times.o cal(B), macron)$ 简易写作 $cal(L)$, $accent(mu times nu, macron)$ 简易写作 $lambda$. \ Suppose $f : X times Y arrow.r bb(C)$ is $cal(L)$-measurable 并且 $f in L^(+)\(lambda\)$ or $f in L^1\(lambda\)$, 则有 - $f_x$ 是 $cal(B)$-measurable 的 for a.e. $x$ 且 $x mapsto integral f_x d nu$ 是 measurable 的 - $f_y$ 是 $cal(A)$-measurable 的 for a.e…

entry.summary: 条件: $\(X\,cal(A)\,mu\)$, $\(Y\,cal(B)\,nu\)$ 为 arbitrary measure space (不需要 $sigma$-finite.), $f : X arrow.r bb(C)$, $g : Y arrow.r bb(C)$ 为 measurable functions. \ 结论: $ h := f g quad upright("is ")\(cal(A) times.o cal(B)\)upright("-measurable") $ 并且如果 $f\,g$ 是 $L^1$ 的, 那么 $h in L^1\(mu times nu\)$ 并且 $ integral h d\(mu times nu\)= \( integral f d mu \) \( integral g d nu \) $

entry.summary: 条件: $f in L^1\(mu times nu\)$, \ 结论: - $f_x in L^1\(nu\)$ for a.e. $x$, $f^y in L^1\(mu\)$ for a.e. - The a.e. defined functions: $ g\(x\):= integral f_x d nu in L^1\(mu\)\,quad h\(x\):= integral f^y d nu in L^1\(nu\) $ - $ integral f d\(mu times nu\)= integral g d mu = integral h d nu \(= integral.double f d mu d nu\) $

entry.summary: Given a set $X$, a collection $C subset cal(P)\(X\)$ is called a monotone class, if it is closed under countable increasing unions and countable decreasing intersections

entry.summary: Suppose $\(X_i\,cal(A)_i\)$ mble, $1 lt.eq i lt.eq n$, the product $sigma$-algebra $A_1 times.o dots.h.c times.o A_n$ on $X_1 times dots.h.c times X_n$ is the smallest $sigma$-algebra s.t. the coordinate map $ pi_j : X_1 times dots.h.c times X_n arrow.r X_j $is measurable. \ 即 the $sigma$-algebra generated by: ${ pi_alpha\(E_alpha\): E_alpha in cal(A_alpha) }$. $ A_1 times.o dots.h.c times.o A_n : = < { pi_alpha\(E_alpha\): E_alpha in cal(A_alpha) } > $

entry.summary: Let $\(X\,cal(A)\,mu\)$, $\(Y\,cal(B)\,nu\)$ be $sigma$-finite measure spaces. \ Take $E in cal(A) times.o cal(B)$. Then: $ x mapsto nu\(E_x\)\,y mapsto mu\(E_y\)upright(" are measurable ") $ 并且 $ \(mu times nu\)\(E\)= integral nu\(E_x\) d mu\(x\)= integral mu\(E^y\) d nu\(y\) $

entry.summary: Let $\(X\,cal(A)\,mu\)$, $\(Y\,cal(B)\,nu\)$ be $sigma$-finite measure spaces. \ 条件: 令 $f in L^(+)\(X times Y\)$, \ 结论:$ g\(x\):= integral f\(x\,y\) d nu in L^(+)\(X\)quad h\(y\):= integral f\(x\,y\) d mu in L^(+)\(Y\) $ (显然) 并且 $ integral f d\(mu times nu\) & = integral \[ integral f\(x\,y\) d nu\(y\)\] d mu\(x\)\ & = integral \[ integral f\(x\,y\) d mu\(x\)\] d nu\(y\) $

text: Let $\(X\,cal(A)\,mu\)$, $\(Y\,cal(B)\,nu\)$ be $sigma$-finite measure spaces. \ 条件: 令 $f in L^(+)\(X times Y\)$, \ 结论:$ g\(x\):= integral f\(x\,y\) d nu in L^(+)\(X\)quad h\(y\):= integral f\(x\,y\) d mu in L^(+)\(Y\) $ (显然) 并且 $ integral f d\(mu times nu\) & = integral \[ integral f\(x\,y\) d nu\(y\)\] d mu\(x\)\ & = integral \[ integral f\(x\,y\) d mu\(x\)\] d nu\(y\) $

entry.summary: 给定 product space 上的集合 $E subset X times Y$, 对于 $x in X$, $y in Y$, 我们定义: $ E_x : = { y in Y divides\(x\,y\)in E } $ $ E^y := { x in X divides\(x\,y\)in Y } $ , caption: [ ] ) 给定从 product space 出发的函数 $f : X times Y arrow.r bb(C)$, 对于 $x in X$, $y in Y$, 我们定义: $ f_x\(y\):= f^y\(x\):= f\(x\,y\) $ 表示固定住一个变量, 另一个变量的变化.
